title: Aether Capacity
description: amd64 reservation headroom and live Talos capacity. Reservation accounting includes only assigned Running/Pending pods, using the greater of summed app-container requests and the largest init-container request. Paired CPU/RAM slots always refer to the same node.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
active AS (
  SELECT Attributes['uid'] AS uid
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'kube_pod_status_phase' AND Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running', 'Pending') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
  GROUP BY uid, Attributes['phase'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix) = 1
),
requests AS (
  SELECT node, resource, sum(greatest(app, init)) AS requested
  FROM (
    SELECT node, uid, resource,
      sumIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_container_resource_requests') AS app,
      maxIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests') AS init
    FROM (
      SELECT MetricName, Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['uid'] AS uid,
        Attributes['resource'] AS resource, Attributes['container'] AS container, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName IN ('kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests')
        AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe') AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory')
        AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      GROUP BY MetricName, node, uid, resource, container
    ) AS latest INNER JOIN active USING (uid)
    GROUP BY node, uid, resource
  ) GROUP BY node, resource
),
capacity AS (
  SELECT node, resource, allocatable, ifNull(requested, 0) AS requested, allocatable - ifNull(requested, 0) AS free
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['resource'] AS resource, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS allocatable
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe')
      AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
    GROUP BY node, resource
  ) AS allocation LEFT JOIN requests USING (node, resource)
)
SELECT node, maxIf(allocatable, resource='cpu') AS cpu_allocatable, maxIf(requested, resource='cpu') AS cpu_requested, maxIf(free, resource='cpu') AS cpu_free, maxIf(allocatable, resource='memory')/1073741824 AS memory_allocatable_gib, maxIf(requested, resource='memory')/1073741824 AS memory_requested_gib, maxIf(free, resource='memory')/1073741824 AS memory_free_gib FROM capacity GROUP BY node ORDER BY cpu_free DESC LIMIT 4

panels.title: Largest Paired Free CPU / RAM Slots

targets.rawSql:
WITH
active AS (
  SELECT Attributes['uid'] AS uid

    SELECT node, uid, resource,
      sumIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_container_resource_requests') AS app,
      maxIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests') AS init
    FROM (
      SELECT MetricName, Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['uid'] AS uid,
        Attributes['resource'] AS resource, Attributes['container'] AS container, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName IN ('kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests')
        AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe') AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory')
        AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      GROUP BY MetricName, node, uid, resource, container
    ) AS latest INNER JOIN active USING (uid)
    GROUP BY node, uid, resource
  ) GROUP BY node, resource
),
capacity AS (
  SELECT node, resource, allocatable, ifNull(requested, 0) AS requested, allocatable - ifNull(requested, 0) AS free
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['resource'] AS resource, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS allocatable
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe')
      AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
    GROUP BY node, resource
  ) AS allocation LEFT JOIN requests USING (node, resource)
)
SELECT node, maxIf(free, resource='cpu') AS free_cpu, maxIf(free, resource='memory')/1073741824 AS free_memory_gib, least(maxIf(free, resource='cpu')/8, maxIf(free, resource='memory')/17179869184) AS large_slot_fraction FROM capacity GROUP BY node ORDER BY large_slot_fraction DESC LIMIT 4

panels.title: Nodes With An 8 CPU + 16 GiB Slot

WITH
active AS (
  SELECT Attributes['uid'] AS uid
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'kube_pod_status_phase' AND Attributes['phase'] IN ('Running', 'Pending') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
  GROUP BY uid, Attributes['phase'] HAVING argMax(Value, TimeUnix) = 1
),
requests AS (
  SELECT node, resource, sum(greatest(app, init)) AS requested
  FROM (
    SELECT node, uid, resource,
      sumIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_container_resource_requests') AS app,
      maxIf(v, MetricName = 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests') AS init
    FROM (
      SELECT MetricName, Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['uid'] AS uid,
        Attributes['resource'] AS resource, Attributes['container'] AS container, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
      WHERE MetricName IN ('kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests')
        AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe') AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory')
        AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
      GROUP BY MetricName, node, uid, resource, container
    ) AS latest INNER JOIN active USING (uid)
    GROUP BY node, uid, resource
  ) GROUP BY node, resource
),
capacity AS (
  SELECT node, resource, allocatable, ifNull(requested, 0) AS requested, allocatable - ifNull(requested, 0) AS free
  FROM (
    SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['resource'] AS resource, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS allocatable
    FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
    WHERE MetricName = 'kube_node_status_allocatable' AND Attributes['node'] IN ('talos-neo','talos-smith','talos-trinity','talos-niobe')
      AND Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
    GROUP BY node, resource
  ) AS allocation LEFT JOIN requests USING (node, resource)
)
SELECT toFloat64(countIf(free_cpu >= 8 AND free_memory >= 17179869184)) AS value
FROM (SELECT node, maxIf(free, resource = 'cpu') AS free_cpu, maxIf(free, resource = 'memory') AS free_memory FROM capacity GROUP BY node)
HAVING count() = 4
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.namespace AS namespace, p.pod AS pod, toFloat64(1) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['namespace'] AS namespace, Attributes['pod'] AS pod, Attributes['uid'] AS uid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'kube_pod_status_phase' AND Attributes['phase'] = 'Pending'
    AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY namespace, pod, uid
) AS p INNER JOIN (
  SELECT Attributes['uid'] AS uid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'kube_pod_status_scheduled' AND Attributes['condition'] = 'false'
    AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY uid
) AS s ON p.uid = s.uid WHERE p.v = 1 AND s.v = 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, toFloat64(argMax(Value, TimeUnix) / 1073741824) AS value
FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes' AND Attributes['node'] != ''
  AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY node LIMIT 20

SELECT node, mountpoint, toFloat64(100 * avail / nullIf(size, 0)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT Attributes['node'] AS node, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint, Attributes['device'] AS device,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'node_filesystem_avail_bytes') AS avail,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'node_filesystem_size_bytes') AS size
  FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('node_filesystem_avail_bytes', 'node_filesystem_size_bytes') AND Attributes['node'] != ''
    AND Attributes['mountpoint'] IN ('/var/mnt/gpu-storage', '/var/mnt/ci') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
  GROUP BY node, mountpoint, device
) WHERE size > 0 LIMIT 100
